name: Gliere
source:
[b]The Reaper of Black Souls・An Angel of Death[/b]

Age: Probably around 20 years old
Height: About average
Bust: Average

She worked in pairs with [url=/c166954]Azrael[/url] (Rui) as an Angel of Death.

Unlike Rui, who is easy-going for the most part, Gliere is dependable.
Though their personalities are different, they get along pretty well, since Rui has been living as a human because of her incarnation, Gliere sometimes comes to check in on her.

*This character has no H-scenes.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/1364175/]Getchu[/url]]
